Mr. M.S. Pal, learned Senior counsel assisted 
by Mr. Medha Pande, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. C.K. Sharma, learned counsel for 
respondent no.1.
3. Mr. R.C. Joshi, learned Standing Counsel for 
the State/respondent nos. 2 and 3.
4. By means of this writ petition, petitioner has 
sought indulgence of this Court for issuing a 
direction to the respondent-Commission to consider 
his case for appointment, on the post of Assistant 
Teacher, L.T. Grade (Science), which according to 
the petitioner has not been considered.
5. Pursuant to the advertisement dated 
13.10.2020, petitioner applied for the post of 
Assistant Teacher, L.T. Grade (Science) under the 
‘Physically Handicapped’ category as General 
Category Candidate, but till date no information has 
been given to the petitioner as to whether he has 
been selected or not?
6. Learned counsel for the respondent￾Corporation prays for and is granted six weeks’ 
time for filing counter affidavit.
7. Further two weeks’ time is granted to the 
learned counsel for the petitioner for filing rejoinder  affidavit.
8. List this case on 21.12.2023.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 20.10.2023
SK
